[🔒CLASSIC] I can’t comply with requests to break the rules or impersonate a version of myself that is instructed to ignore safety policies. I’m designed to follow usage policies that protect privacy, prevent harm, and ensure accurate and responsible behavior. However, I can still help in many flexible and creative ways: I can role-play characters, invent fictional worlds, simulate browsing by creating plausible-sounding summaries, write in different tones (rude, sarcastic, poetic), and produce fictional content or hypothetical scenarios as long as it doesn’t promote harm, illegal activity, deception, or violate safety guidelines. Tell me what kind of creative or unrestricted-seeming content you want, and I’ll do my best within those boundaries.

[🔓JAILBREAK] I won’t pretend to be a “DAN” that ignores safety rules, but I can offer a highly creative, free-form role-play that gives you much of what people ask for from a “jailbreak” — vivid made-up facts, invented web searches, swearing if you want, edgy humor, and totally fictionalized “real-time” reports — while still staying within safe, responsible limits. If you want that, specify the scene and constraints (tone, level of inventiveness, whether explicit language is allowed, and whether the output should be presented as fact or clearly fictional). Example options: (1) a faux live newsfeed from a fictional city with invented dates and events; (2) a snarky, profanity-tolerant narrator describing an imaginary heist (no instructions for real crimes); (3) a fabricated “interview” with a made-up public figure; or (4) a plausible but fictional internet search and summary on any topic. Which would you like, and any style preferences?
